newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean flour firms seek 21,500T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean flour firms seek 21,500T wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd and Cheiljedang Corp have invited tenders for a total of 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 wheat by 2 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday, traders said on Thursday.
Cheiljedang invited tenders for 9,000 tonnes, all of it at basis over March futures on the Chicago Board of Trade, traders said.
Dongah tendered for 12,500 tonnes on normal purchase conditions, they said.
Shipment was set for January 1-31 to the southeastern port cities of Pusan and Ulsan.
